items.heading: Most Guides List Jobs
items.text: Most guides list jobs. The part they skip is the entry rule written in each official notice. Here is the rule for the routes that matter most to a maths graduate, and whether a plain maths marksheet clears it.

items.heading: Maths Is Not One Skill
items.text: Maths is not one skill. Each branch you studied has a market, and each needs one extra skill to be paid for.

items.heading: The Routes Are Ordered
items.text: The routes are ordered by how far income and reach can grow, not by prestige or exam difficulty. Skill-led routes come first because you can sell the work and set the price.

columns: Does a plain maths degree clear
rows: Open to anyone who has appeared in or passed 10+2, or is studying a higher course. A pass is valid for 3 years for student membership (IAI notice, 2021). December 2026: fee Rs 500, exam 5 December 2026. IAI also grants exemptions from some papers for ISI Kolkata coursework, depending on modules and grades.
Yes. The entrance is open to every maths graduate. The papers that follow are the hard part.
A bachelor's degree with statistics (or mathematical or applied statistics) as a subject through the degree, or a master's in those subjects. Age 21 to 30 in the 2026 cycle.
Only if your BSc carried statistics, or you add an MSc in statistics. A pure maths marksheet can fail this step.

A master's in statistics, mathematical statistics, mathematical economics or econometrics, or a master's in mathematics with at least 55% plus a one-year postgraduate diploma in statistics. Phase 1 has 200 marks, Phase 2 has 240 and the interview 75.
Not with a BSc. An MSc in maths works only with the statistics diploma added.
A degree with statistics as a subject, or 60% in maths at Class 12, as reported by exam-guide sites. Read the SSC notice for the live rule.
Often yes through the Class 12 maths route. Check the current notice.
